findings.detail: RecursiveReviewScope: invariants include complete recursive review inputs and correct immutable repository/revision context for applicable guidance. Ratings: encapsulation 7/10, invariant expression 6/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 6/10. Recursive rendering includes module/src/file.go, but render_guides resolves module/AGENTS.md using the superproject's revision and object database, which cannot cross the gitlink. Required child instructions are omitted while review can succeed. This is the known historical-child-guidance finding, retained under the explicit record-without-fixing disposition.
findings.fix: In the recorded follow-up, resolve child guidance in the child's object database at the gitlink revision selected by the trusted parent baseline, recursively; handle absent baseline children explicitly and fail diagnostically for unavailable required objects.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Checked commands, recursive review omits trusted child guidance.

summary: Reviewed the full specified committed scope and its changed data contracts; no new Important or Critical type-design defects were found. The known historical-child-guidance finding remains recorded without fixing, as directed. No files were changed and tests requiring writes were not run.
